archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY mixed with ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST

rules: Never use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings.
Data labels, sources, and micro-copy must be uppercase, tiny, with wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Use JetBrains Mono for metrics, percentages (like the 82% alignment score), and Perplexity-style reference tags.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with a strict 1px inner border (border-white/10) for the persistent Right AI Panel and headers.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the grid skeleton. Use 1px solid border-white/10 for cards instead of heavy shadows. Gives a tactical, high-end terminal feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: The Vision Board canvas should have a subtle dotted grid background pattern (radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 1px, transparent 1px)).
visual_enhancers.kairos_mode: When the spiritual/values Kairos filter is active, relevant cards should gently pulse with an amber glow (shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(245,158,11,0.15)]).

layouts.global_structure: h-screen w-full flex overflow-hidden. A left/top slim nav, a main expansive center area (the Canvas or Vision Dashboard), and a STRICTLY persistent fixed Right AI Panel (w-80 or w-96).
layouts.vision_home: High-density 'Bento' grid. Gap-6. Hero cell (span 8) showing alignment score, Circular Score cell (span 4), and smaller cells for KPIs and fast actions.
layouts.vision_board_canvas: Infinite pan/zoom layout. Cards are absolutely positioned. Connected via SVG paths. Cursor should be grab/grabbing.
layouts.right_ai_panel: Always on the right. flex-col layout. Top section for Live Alignment Score, middle for scrolling 'Proactive Discovery' feed, bottom for the Perplexity-style chat input.

components.intelligent_cards: Cardless or flat rectangular styling. bg-[#121217], border-white/10. On hover: -translate-y-1, border-[#9333EA]/50, shadow-lg shadow-[#9333EA]/10.
components.ai_badges: Small pill tags on cards to indicate AI updates. bg-[#9333EA]/15 text-[#D8B4FE] border border-[#9333EA]/30. text-xs tracking-widest.
components.perplexity_sources: Inline small rounded squares in the AI Chat. bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded cursor-pointer transition-colors.
components.circular_business_score: SVG-based segmented ring chart or radar chart highlighting 6 pillars: Vision, Execution, Finance, Impact, Energy, Growth.

motion.micro_interactions: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease. Never use 'transition: all'.
motion.feed_entrance: Staggered entrance for the AI Activity Feed and Hub Chat messages.
motion.canvas_connections: Use subtle animated dashed lines (stroke-dasharray) for data flowing between connected canvas cards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 ratio against #09090B. Use text-shadow if layered over gradients.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='ai-chat-input').

image_urls.description: Deep black subtle geometric texture. Use as a very low opacity overlay (5%) on the Vision Home hero card.
Abstract glowing sphere. Use as a background visual inside the Circular Business Score widget.
Premium entrepreneur portrait for the user profile badge in the top navigation or right panel.

3d_libraries.recommended: Visx or Recharts for the Circular Business Score. ReactFlow for the Infinite Canvas (Vision Board).
3d_libraries.canvas_rules: The canvas is a 2D infinite workspace, but it must feel premium with smooth scrolling and high-fidelity card rendering.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add '.App { text-align: center; }'. Keep everything left-aligned to mimic a technical terminal.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders. Do NOT use soft, muddy drop shadows.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Every interaction needs micro-animations. Connect the cards in the canvas visually.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The layout must strictly incorporate the Persistent Right AI Panel on ALL pages. Do not hide it behind a hamburger menu on desktop.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do NOT use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use precise Lucide icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements to support rigorous testing.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do not use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or dropdowns. ALWAYS apply bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl if seeing through is desired.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Generate .js/.jsx files for React components, not .tsx files.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Create depth through layered design elements. Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). Never apply universal 'transition: all'. Do not center align the app container. Use Sonner for toasts. Emulate a luxury investor-demo ready interface.
